definitions.explanation: An increase to twice the original amount, or more broadly, a dramatic increase in quantity or intensity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plan to double the budget.

examples.japanese: {防衛費|ぼうえいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}をめぐって⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Debate continues in the Diet over doubling the defense budget.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ (double, times) + {増|ぞう} (increase). Strictly means "doubling," but sometimes used loosely for any dramatic increase.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {倍増|ばいぞう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to double (intransitive — something doubles on its own)
- {倍増|ばいぞう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to double something (transitive/causative)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: sales double
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to double the budget
- {生産量|せいさんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}: doubling of production
- {防衛費|ぼうえいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{倍増|ばいぞう}: doubling defense spending

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧: double, times (e.g., ２⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ = twice)
- ⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧: increase (general term)
- ⟦{急増|きゅうぞう}→急増：12671_kyuuzou⟧: sharp/sudden increase
- {半減|はんげん}: halving (opposite pattern)
